findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded before translate caches a miss
findings.body: I18n.translate only calls load_locale for config.locale, and the new fallback chain (site default locale, then :en) is loaded solely from ApplicationController#set_locale via I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. Any I18n.t outside that filter—mailers, jobs, models, middleware, or a request that translates before set_locale—looks up fallbacks whose YAML was never loaded. The accelerator then freezes that result in the process-wide LRU (including the default missing-translation string). Later requests that do load :en still serve the cached miss until the entry is evicted or the process restarts, so users see raw keys instead of the intended site-locale or English fallback.

findings.title: Translation cache ignores the site fallback locale
findings.body: The LRU key is only key + I18n.locale + backend object_id. FallbackLocaleList resolves misses using SiteSetting.default_locale, but that value is not part of the key and nothing clears @cache when the setting changes. After an admin changes the site default locale, strings already resolved through the old fallback stay cached for each user locale, so the UI keeps showing the previous language until restart or an unrelated I18n.reload!.

findings.title: Every fallback lookup reads SiteSetting.default_locale
findings.body: Backend::Fallbacks calls I18n.fallbacks[locale] on each translate, and FallbackLocaleList#[] unconditionally calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym. That runs for every I18n.t once this initializer is loaded, including asset precompile, migrations, and boot paths where the settings store/DB is not available. Those tasks previously did not enable i18n fallbacks (the flag lived only in production/profile). They can now raise while building the fallback list, and a nil default_locale raises NoMethodError on to_sym instead of degrading to :en.

findings.title: No tests for fallback order or lazy locale loading
findings.body: The custom chain (requested locale, SiteSetting.default_locale, :en), the move of fallbacks out of the environment configs, and ensure_loaded! are untested. A regression that drops :en, skips loading a fallback file, or caches a miss would ship unnoticed, which is exactly the failure mode this change introduces next to the translate accelerator.
